title: 第21章 房里有鬼第22章 群鬼死因
slug: 两界我的金手指有点无敌
content_zh:
走出电梯。
入眼是一面ALias装甲门，打开门对面的墙壁是是鱼肚白大理石，右转进入客厅可以看出这套房整体是现代轻奢风。
整套房虽然有三百八十平，却只做了三房，光是一个客厅加餐厅就有一百一十平，两边是全景落地窗，可以看到一线江景。
这种通透性是别墅绝对比不了的。
眼睛可以看得到的地方是绝对看不到大白墙，要不是大理石，要不就是烟熏木。
阳台是一个L形的转角，阳台上配备了一个恒温的游泳池，三十天内不用换水，大概有个两米宽，七八米长。
但这个游泳池用的时候是可以自动盖起来的。
厨房是开放性的，西厨加中厨等一系列厨具加起来值五十万，当然，这是王城的说法，具体值多少顾铮不清楚，但是价格一定不低。
跟着王城转了一圈，一边看他一边讲解：
“这个小区自带会所，健身房，瑜伽房……市价一千一百万，若非闹鬼之说，四百八十万想拿下这套房基本上是做梦……”
然而顾铮根本没有听他说话，因为他的确在这套房中感受到了非常浓的阴气，因此早就在进门的时候就以符箓开了阴阳眼。
在房子中，他看到了七只鬼。
趴在吊顶灯上的一只鬼脖子乌青，怕是有一尺来长，舌头耷拉在嘴边，应该是一只吊死鬼。
站在电视机旁边的全身湿漉漉的，全身浮肿，大概是被淹死的。
跟在王城后面的是一只无头鬼，鬼手里提着自己的脑袋，生前不知道被谁砍头了。
站在王城前面的胸部血肉模糊，肠子内脏隐约可见，似乎是出了车祸。
…………
顾铮在大乾位面也只在鬼市看到过这么多鬼，这么多鬼挤到一间房子里，他不禁啧啧称奇。
这些鬼也没想到有阴阳眼这玩意，看到顾铮环顾四周，只当他在看房子。
七只鬼就这么当着顾铮的面‘大声密谋’，凑到一块说话，顾铮也光明正大的‘窃听’起来。

“哼哼！这些人真是不知死活，吓走一个又来一个！”
“没事！来多少个吓多少个，这地方是咱们的地盘，总不能让活人占了！”
“善！”
吊死鬼迟疑道：“这次咱们怎么吓他？”
“这简单，绊他们几下保管他们吓的屁滚尿流！”
“我觉得不保险，还是用关灯的法子，不停的开灯关灯，他们更吃这一套。”
“我觉得鬼遮眼更有用，忽然蒙住眼睛，什么都看不见了，肯定能吓的魂飞魄散。”
“别争了！干脆一起用，来个大的，最好吓的没人敢来这里打扰咱们。”淹死鬼听的脑壳痛，一锤定音做出决定。
王城嘴巴都说干了，眼巴巴的问道：“顾铮，错过这村就没这店，这样实惠的房子，全国你都找不到第二套！”
他拍着胸脯，信誓旦旦，顾铮却是不置可否。
的确，一套房里有七只鬼，全国真的很难找出第二套。
嘭！
顾铮还没说话，王城就摔了个大马哈，还好摔在地毯上，没什么问题，他没在意，站起来尴尬的笑了笑，下一刻那吊死鬼抓住他的腿狠狠一拽令他一屁股坐地上。
这次王城感觉到了不对劲，瞬间冷汗涔涔，慢慢爬起来四下环顾，颤声道：“这……这什么……什么情况……不会真的有鬼吧……”
嘭！
一间敞开的卧室门忽然关上。
灯也一下来一下关，灯光闪烁不定。
content_en:
Get out of the elevator.
The first thing you see is an ALias armored door. When you open the door, the wall opposite is made of fish belly white marble. When you turn right and enter the living room, you can see that the entire suite is modern and light luxury.
Although the entire suite has an area of ​​380 square meters, it only has three rooms. The living room and dining room alone have an area of ​​110 square meters. There are panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows on both sides, giving you a view of the river.
This kind of transparency is absolutely unmatched by villas.
There is absolutely no big white wall as far as the eye can see, either marble or smoked wood.
The balcony is an L-shaped corner. The balcony is equipped with a constant-temperature swimming pool. The water does not need to be changed for thirty days. It is about two meters wide and seven or eight meters long.
But this swimming pool can be covered automatically when used.
The kitchen is open, and a series of kitchen utensils such as a Western kitchen and a Chinese kitchen are worth five hundred thousand in total. Of course, this is Wang Cheng's statement. Gu Zheng is not sure how much it is worth, but the price must not be low.
I followed Wang Cheng around, watching him while explaining:
"This community has its own clubhouse, gym, and yoga room... The market price is 11 million. If it weren't for being haunted, it would be basically a dream to buy this apartment for 4.8 million..."
However, Gu Zheng didn't listen to him at all, because he did feel a very strong yin energy in this suite, so he opened the yin and yang eyes with the talisman when he entered.
In the house, he saw seven ghosts.
The ghost lying on the chandelier had a black neck, probably a foot long, and its tongue was hanging out of its mouth. It must be a hanged ghost.
The man standing next to the TV was wet and swollen, probably from drowning.
Following Wang Cheng was a headless ghost. The ghost held his own head in his hand. He didn't know who had beheaded him before he was alive.
The chest standing in front of the royal city was bloody and bloody, and his intestines and internal organs were vaguely visible, as if he had been in a car accident.
…………
In the Daqian plane, Gu Zheng had only seen so many ghosts in the ghost market. He couldn't help but be amazed that so many ghosts were crowded into one house.
These ghosts didn't expect that there was such a thing as yin and yang eyes. When they saw Gu Zheng looking around, they just thought he was looking at the house.
The seven ghosts just 'conspired loudly' in front of Gu Zheng. They gathered together to talk, and Gu Zheng also started to 'eavesdrop' openly.
"Humph! These people are really desperate, scaring away one after another!"
"It's okay! Come and scare as many as you want, this place is our territory, we can't let living people occupy it!"
"Good!"
The hanged man hesitated and said, "How can we scare him this time?"
"It's easy, just trip them a few times and scare the shit out of them!"
"I don't think it's safe. We should turn off the lights and keep turning them on and off. They'll do this even more."
"I think it's more useful to have a ghost cover your eyes. If you suddenly cover your eyes and can't see anything, it will definitely scare you out of your wits."
"Stop arguing! Let's just use it together, a big one. It's best to scare us so that no one dares to come here to disturb us." The drowned ghost's head hurt when he heard it, and he made a final decision.
Wang Cheng's mouth was dry, and he asked eagerly: "Gu Zheng, if you miss this village, there won't be this store. You can't find another house with such an affordable price in the whole country!"
He patted his chest and vowed, but Gu Zheng was noncommittal.
Indeed, there are seven ghosts in one apartment, and it is really difficult to find the second one in the country.
Bang!
Before Gu Zheng could say anything, Wang Cheng fell hard. Fortunately, he fell on the carpet, so there was no problem. He didn't care, stood up and smiled awkwardly. The next moment, the hanged man grabbed his legs and pulled him hard, making him sit on the ground.
This time Wang Cheng felt something was wrong. He suddenly broke out in cold sweat. He slowly got up and looked around. He said in a trembling voice: "This... what... what is going on... there can't really be a ghost..."
Bang!
An open bedroom door suddenly closed.
The lights also turned off and on, flickering.
